notes: Hermetic runtime cell catalog for the RFC 9421 negative battery. A cell is (language, pinned runtime image). Each cell runs that language's runner against the one frozen, signed corpus inside its pinned image, building/installing deps fresh in-container so the verdict is shown to hold in a clean, independent runtime, not just on the build host. Images are pinned by tag here; the exact repo digest is resolved at run time and embedded in the sealed receipt (kaf/run_cells.sh -> cells.results.json -> seal_receipt.py). This is the KAF 'Cells' axis for L2; the 'Agreement' axis is the 10-way consensus in tools/run_consensus.sh.
